signatures.description: Symptom: config aliases: block parsed fine, docs documented it, but `openapi-cli <alias>` -> unknown command exit 1. Root cause: no dispatch step ever rewrote argv — the config key was loaded but never consumed; a config key only the loader knows about is indistinguishable from a typo'd key. Fix: internal/builtin/root.go rewrites argv[1] from the aliases map at command construction (SetArgs before ExecuteContext). Rule: every config-driven behaviour needs a regression test that starts from a config file on disk.
